root_cause: Commercial Visa credit transactions are being downgraded to higher-cost consumer interchange rates because Level 2/3 commercial card data is not being transmitted to the processor.
diagnosis: The consistent fee overcharge across all three transactions (totaling Rs 785.34) indicates that the gateway is applying a higher blended or consumer MDR rate instead of the lower commercial interchange rate. This occurs because the necessary Level 2/3 data (e.g., cardholder name, POI data) is missing, causing the transaction to be downgraded in the interchange network. Note: This analysis uses a modeled benchmark as the source status is illustrative.
action_rationale: Providing Level 2/3 commercial card data will prevent the interchange downgrade, ensuring transactions are processed at the correct, lower commercial rate.
